**PJB** is the original OrcaSlicer 2.5.1 with Pawel Jarczak's Bambu network-plugin bridge added, so Bambu cloud printers keep working. On Windows the plugin runs inside a bundled WSL2 runtime; on Linux it runs natively. We plan to rebuild it for every official OrcaSlicer release to stay in sync with upstream.

## What's new
- **Based on OrcaSlicer 2.5.1.** For everything that changed in OrcaSlicer itself, see the official [2.5.0](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/releases/tag/v2.5.0) and [2.5.1](https://github.com/OrcaSlicer/OrcaSlicer/releases/tag/v2.5.1) release notes.
- **Windows:** the bridge now runs Bambu network plugin 02.08.04, the version OrcaSlicer 2.5 is built for. When you upgrade from 2.4.2-PJB.2, Orca switches to it on its own and downloads it on first launch.
- **Windows:** the camera live view works with the X2D and other printers that stream video the same way.

## Known issues
- **Windows:** the first launch after a fresh install or an upgrade sets up the WSL2 runtime again, which can take several minutes (slower on virtual machines). A PowerShell window shows progress, and Orca may look unresponsive until it finishes.
- **Windows:** only network plugin 02.08.04 can be used. Older versions (02.03.00 and the legacy plugin) no longer appear in the plugin version list, because the bridge can't run them with OrcaSlicer 2.5.
- **Windows:** the filament spool manager that is new in OrcaSlicer 2.5 has not been tested with the bridge yet.
- **Windows:** publishing a project to MakerWorld from inside OrcaSlicer doesn't work through the bridge.
- **Linux:** after upgrading from 2.4.2, Orca keeps using the older network plugin 02.03.00, and sending a print through the cloud fails with error -3120 ("403, internal blocking"). Switch to 02.08.04 under Preferences → Bambu network plug-in → Network plug-in version, or accept the plugin update Orca offers at startup. Orca downloads it and asks you to restart.

## Downloads
| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows | `OrcaSlicer_Windows_Installer_V2.5.1_x64.exe` (installer) or `OrcaSlicer_Windows_V2.5.1_portable.zip` |
| Ubuntu / Debian | `.deb` for Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04, or the `LinuxDir` `.tar.gz` (unpack and run) |
| Any Linux | `OrcaSlicer-BMCU_Linux_AppImage_…AppImage` |
| Fedora 42–44 | `.rpm` for your Fedora version |
| Other Fedora versions | `orcaslicer-bmcu-2.5.1_PJB.1-1.src.rpm` (source RPM): run `sudo dnf builddep` on it, then `rpmbuild --rebuild`. Building takes a few hours and needs internet access. |

Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
